```{r}
#Per Gestire il problema dei NA li sostitutiamo con "unknown"

smpDt = data.frame(sample_data(ps_filt))

smpDt$HYP_drug1[is.na(smpDt$HYP_drug1)] <- "unknown"
smpDt$HYP_drug2[is.na(smpDt$HYP_drug2)] <- "unknown"
smpDt$HYP_drug3[is.na(smpDt$HYP_drug3)] <- "unknown"
smpDt$HYP_drug4[is.na(smpDt$HYP_drug4)] <- "unknown"
smpDt$HYP_drug5[is.na(smpDt$HYP_drug5)] <- "unknown"

smpDt$DYSL_drug1[is.na(smpDt$DYSL_drug1)] <- "unknown"
smpDt$DYSL_drug2[is.na(smpDt$DYSL_drug2)] <- "unknown"
smpDt$DYSL_drug3[is.na(smpDt$DYSL_drug3)] <- "unknown"

#smpDt$glucose_0[is.na(smpDt$glucose_0)] <- "unknown"

smpDt$"HyperglicemiaMetS"= NA
smpDt$"TrygliceridesMetS" = NA
smpDt$"HypertensionMets" = NA
smpDt$"AbdominalObesityMetS" = NA
smpDt$"HDL_MetS" = NA
```

**MetS Risk factors - Criteria Utilized** <br> <button class="btn btn-primary" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#cella2">Expand/Collapse</button>

::: {#cella2 .collapse}
```{r echo=TRUE}
# Assegna 0 ai restanti
smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS[!(smpDt$glucose_0 > 100 | smpDt$diabetes == 1)] <- 0

#Hyperglicemia
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con glicemia a digiuno > 100 o diabetici
smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS[smpDt$glucose_0 > 100 | smpDt$diabetes == 1] <- 1

#Se glucose_0 è NA ma la d
smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS[(is.na(smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS) & (smpDt$diabetes == 1))] <- 1
smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS[(is.na(smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS) & (smpDt$diabetes == 0))] <- 0



#Abdominal Obesity
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con Waist > 94 e sex = 0 
smpDt$AbdominalObesityMetS[smpDt$waist > 94 & smpDt$sex == 0] <- 1
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con Waist < 94 e sex = 0 
smpDt$AbdominalObesityMetS[smpDt$waist <= 94 & smpDt$sex == 0] <- 0

# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con Waist > 80 e sex = 1 
smpDt$AbdominalObesityMetS[smpDt$waist > 80 & smpDt$sex == 1] <- 1
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con Waist < 80 e sex = 1 
smpDt$AbdominalObesityMetS[smpDt$waist <= 80 & smpDt$sex == 1] <- 0


#Hypertension
#Abdominal Obesity
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con ((sbp > 130 o dbp < 85) e sex = 0) o (HypDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$HypertensionMets[((smpDt$sbp > 130 | smpDt$dbp > 85) | (smpDt$HYP_drug1 == 1 | smpDt$HYP_drug2 == 1 | smpDt$HYP_drug3 == 1 |
                                                              smpDt$HYP_drug4 == 1 | smpDt$HYP_drug5 == 1))] <- 1
# Assegna 0 agli altri
smpDt$HypertensionMets[((smpDt$sbp <= 130 & smpDt$dbp < 85) & (smpDt$HYP_drug1 != 1 & smpDt$HYP_drug2 != 1 & smpDt$HYP_drug3 != 1 &
                                                              smpDt$HYP_drug4 != 1 & smpDt$HYP_drug5 != 1))] <- 0

#HDL-CholesterolMetS
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con (HDL < 40 e sex = 0) o (DyslDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$HDL_MetS[((smpDt$HDL < 40 & smpDt$sex == 0) | (smpDt$DYSL_drug1 == 1 | smpDt$DYSL_drug2 == 1 | smpDt$DYSL_drug3 == 1))] <- 1
# Assegna 0 ai soggetti con (HDL > 40 e sex = 0) o (DyslDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$HDL_MetS[((smpDt$HDL >= 40 & smpDt$sex == 0) & (smpDt$DYSL_drug1 != 1 & smpDt$DYSL_drug2 != 1 & smpDt$DYSL_drug3 != 1))] <- 0

# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con (HDL < 50 e sex = 1) o (DyslDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$HDL_MetS[((smpDt$HDL < 50 & smpDt$sex == 1) | (smpDt$DYSL_drug1 == 1 | smpDt$DYSL_drug2 == 1 | smpDt$DYSL_drug3 == 1))] <- 1
# Assegna 0 ai soggetti con (HDL < 50 e sex = 1) o (DyslDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$HDL_MetS[((smpDt$HDL >= 50 & smpDt$sex == 1) & (smpDt$DYSL_drug1 != 1 & smpDt$DYSL_drug2 != 1 & smpDt$DYSL_drug3 != 1))] <- 0



#Tryglicerides
# Assegna 1 ai soggetti con (Tryglicerides < 40 e sex = 0) o (DyslDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$TrygliceridesMetS[((smpDt$triglycerides > 150) | (smpDt$DYSL_drug1 == 1 | smpDt$DYSL_drug2 == 1 | smpDt$DYSL_drug3 == 1))] <- 1
# Assegna 0 ai soggetti con (HDL > 40 e sex = 0) o (DyslDrug1-2-3 = 1) 
smpDt$TrygliceridesMetS[!((smpDt$triglycerides > 150) & (smpDt$DYSL_drug1 != 1 & smpDt$DYSL_drug2 != 1 & smpDt$DYSL_drug3 != 1 ))] <- 0

#Definizione Sindrome metabolica
variables <- c("HyperglicemiaMetS", "TrygliceridesMetS", "HypertensionMets", "HDL_MetS")

smpDt$"MetS" = 0
smpDt$MetS[rowSums(smpDt[, variables]) >=2] = 1
```
:::

```{r}
#Selezioniamo i pazienti per cui sono presenti NA nelle variabil della MetS
HyperglicemyMissing = (smpDt[is.na(smpDt$HyperglicemiaMetS),c("glucose_0", "diabetes") ])
HyperglicemyMissing2 = (smpDt[is.na(smpDt$glucose_0),c("glucose_0", "diabetes") ])
HyperglicemyMissing = rbind(HyperglicemyMissing, HyperglicemyMissing2)
# AbdominalObesityMetSMissing = (smpDt[is.na(smpDt$AbdominalObesityMetS), ])
HypertensionMetsMissing = (smpDt[is.na(smpDt$HypertensionMets), c("HypertensionMets","sbp", "dbp", "HYP_drug1", "HYP_drug2", 
                                                                  "HYP_drug3", "HYP_drug4", "HYP_drug5" )])

HDL_MetSMissing = (smpDt[is.na(smpDt$HDL_MetS), c("HDL_MetS", "HDL", "sex", "DYSL_drug1", "DYSL_drug2", "DYSL_drug3" )])
TrygliceridesMetSMissing = (smpDt[is.na(smpDt$TrygliceridesMetS),c("TrygliceridesMetS", "triglycerides","DYSL_drug1", "DYSL_drug2", "DYSL_drug3" ) ])


missings = list("HyperglicemiaMetS" = HyperglicemyMissing,
             "HypertensionMets" = HypertensionMetsMissing,
             "HDL_MetS" = HDL_MetSMissing,
             "TrygliceridesMetS" = TrygliceridesMetSMissing
             )

for (var in names(missings)) {
  missings[[var]][is.na(missings[[var]])] <- "unknown"
  missings[[var]] = as.data.frame(missings[[var]])
}
missings[["sampleData"]] = smpDt
openxlsx::write.xlsx(missings, file = "../results/MetS_RiskFactors/MetS_RisksFactors.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
